from manim import *

class PlasmaPhysicsIntro(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title
        title = Text("Introduction to Plasma Physics", font_size=48)
        subtitle = Text("The Fourth State of Matter", font_size=28, color=BLUE)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle))
        
        # Part 1: Neutral Gas
        gas_text = Text("Neutral Gas", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Write(gas_text))
        
        # Create atoms (proton + electron orbiting)
        atoms = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            atom = VGroup()
            nucleus = Dot(color=RED).scale(2)
            electron = Dot(color=BLUE).scale(1)
            orbit = Circle(radius=0.5, color=GRAY).move_to(nucleus.get_center())
            electron.move_to(nucleus.get_center() + RIGHT * 0.5)
            atom.add(nucleus, electron, orbit)
            atom.move_to([-4 + i*2, 0, 0])
            atoms.add(atom)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(atoms))
        
        # Animate electrons orbiting
        def rotate_electron(mob, dt):
            for atom in mob:
                electron = atom[1]
                center = atom[0].get_center()
                electron.rotate(2*dt, about_point=center)
        
        atoms.add_updater(rotate_electron)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Part 2: Ionization
        ion_text = Text("Ionization → Plasma", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Transform(gas_text, ion_text))
        
        # Energy flash
        flash = Flash(ORIGIN, line_length=0.5, num_lines=12, color=YELLOW)
        self.play(flash)
        
        # Break apart atoms
        electrons = VGroup()
        ions = VGroup()
        
        for atom in atoms:
            nucleus = atom[0]
            electron = atom[1]
            orbit = atom[2]
            
            # Stop updater first
            atoms.remove_updater(rotate_electron)
            
            new_nucleus = nucleus.copy()
            new_electron = electron.copy()
            
            ions.add(new_nucleus)
            electrons.add(new_electron)
            
            self.remove(atom)
        
        self.add(ions, electrons)
        
        # Animate separation
        self.play(
            electrons.animate.shift(UP*1.5 + np.random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, size=(5,3))),
            ions.animate.shift(DOWN*0.5),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Part 3: Magnetic Confinement
        self.play(FadeOut(gas_text))
        mag_text = Text("Magnetic Confinement", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Write(mag_text))
        
        # B-field lines (out of page dots, into page crosses)
        field_dots = VGroup()
        field_crosses = VGroup()
        
        for x in range(-6, 7, 2):
            for y in range(-3, 4, 2):
                if (x + y) % 4 == 0:
                    dot = Dot(color=GREEN).scale(0.8).move_to([x*0.5, y*0.5, 0])
                    field_dots.add(dot)
                else:
                    cross = VGroup(
                        Line(UL, DR, color=GREEN).scale(0.2),
                        Line(UR, DL, color=GREEN).scale(0.2)
                    ).move_to([x*0.5, y*0.5, 0])
                    field_crosses.add(cross)
        
        b_label = MathTex("\\vec{B}", color=GREEN).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(UP)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(field_dots, lag_ratio=0.1),
            FadeIn(field_crosses, lag_ratio=0.1),
            Write(b_label)
        )
        
        # Gyration animation
        def gyrate_particles(mob, dt, centers, radii, speeds, phases, is_electron):
            for i, p in enumerate(mob):
                angle = speeds[i] * dt
                new_pos = centers[i] + radii[i] * np.array([
                    np.cos(phases[i] + angle), 
                    np.sin(phases[i] + angle), 
                    0
                ])
                p.move_to(new_pos)
                phases[i] += angle
        
        e_centers = [e.get_center() for e in electrons]
        i_centers = [i.get_center() for i in ions]
        e_radii = [0.4] * 5
        i_radii = [0.8] * 5  # ions gyrate with larger radius
        e_speeds = [3] * 5
        i_speeds = [-1] * 5  # opposite direction
        e_phases = [0] * 5
        i_phases = [0] * 5
        
        electrons.add_updater(lambda m, dt: gyrate_particles(m, dt, e_centers, e_radii, e_speeds, e_phases, True))
        ions.add_updater(lambda m, dt: gyrate_particles(m, dt, i_centers, i_radii, i_speeds, i_phases, False))
        
        self.wait(4)
        
        electrons.remove_updater(lambda m, dt: gyrate_particles(m, dt, e_centers, e_radii, e_speeds, e_phases, True))
        ions.remove_updater(lambda m, dt: gyrate_particles(m, dt, i_centers, i_radii, i_speeds, i_phases, False))
        
        # Fade everything out and show summary
        self.play(FadeOut(ions), FadeOut(electrons), FadeOut(field_dots), FadeOut(field_crosses), FadeOut(mag_text), FadeOut(b_label))
        
        summary = BulletedList(
            "Plasma: ionized gas with free electrons and ions",
            "Collective behavior: long-range electromagnetic interactions",
            "Magnetic confinement: charged particles gyrate around $\\vec{B}$",
            "Key for fusion energy, astrophysics, and space propulsion"
        ).scale(0.8)
        
        self.play(Write(summary), run_time=3)
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(summary))
